OH1-a.rule: every 1 s analysis window, every condition, both cards: dhot <= +4 C (FAIL if any >= +5)

OH1-b.rule: per block median dhot(ONE-C) <= median dhot(B4C); PASS in >= 2 of 3 blocks on aifoundry3 and 2 of 2 on card 1

OH1-c.rule: per card, pooled over blocks: |median dhot(condition) - median dhot(IDLE)| <= 1 C for ONE-C, ONE-NE, B4C

near_65_note: descriptive: every ok 1 s window of the OH-1 blocks whose mean read 64-66 C (the governor's decision point), any phase
